ingredients.title: Crust
items: 1½ cups graham cracker crumbs
¼ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp ground cinnamon
6 tbsp unsalted butter, melted

ingredients.title: Filling
items: 24 oz (680 g) cream cheese, softened
¾ cup granulated sugar
2 large eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp ground cinnamon
2 ripe bananas, mashed
½ cup sour cream

ingredients.title: Chocolate Swirl
items: ½ cup semisweet chocolate chips, melted

ingredients.title: Topping (optional)
items: Whipped cream
Sliced bananas
Grated chocolate or chocolate shavings

instructions.title: Prep
items: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Grease a 9-inch springform pan and set aside.

instructions.title: Crust
items: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and cinnamon.
Stir in melted butter until fully combined.
Press mixture firmly into the bottom of the pan.
Bake crust for 8–10 minutes, then let it cool completely.

instructions.title: Filling
items: Beat cream cheese until smooth and creamy.
Add sugar and cinnamon, mixing until combined.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing after each addition.
Mix in vanilla extract, mashed bananas, and sour cream until smooth.

instructions.title: Assembly
items: Pour half of the filling into the cooled crust.
Drizzle half of the melted chocolate over the filling.
Add remaining filling on top.
Drizzle remaining melted chocolate.
Swirl gently with a knife or skewer to create a marbled effect.

instructions.title: Baking
items: Bake for 55–65 minutes until the center is almost set but slightly jiggly.
Turn off oven, crack the door, and let cheesecake cool inside for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Chilling
items: Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight, before serving.

instructions.title: Finishing
items: Top with whipped cream if desired.
Add sliced bananas on top.
Sprinkle or drizzle with chocolate shavings.

serving_suggestions: Add whipped cream and chocolate drizzle
Pair with coffee or dessert wine
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days
Freeze uncut slices for up to 2 months
